facts.back-view: A man with his back turned stands on a cliff, looking down at the sea.
facts.three-wands: Three wands are planted in the ground, and the man holds the right-hand one in one hand.
facts.ships: Three small ships float on the yellowish sea.
facts.robes: Over a red garment he wears a green cloak on one shoulder, with a checkered band around him.
facts.headband: A white band is tied around his head.
facts.yellow-sky: The sky and the sea are all yellow, and mountains show far off.

glosses.back-view: A gaze that looks farther ahead while waiting for what has already been sent out.
glosses.three-wands: Looking to what comes next, with a footing already set.

reversedGloss.blocked: What was sent out does not come back, and the wait grows long.
reversedGloss.waning: The widening view and expectation shrink.

misdescriptions.wrong: He sets off on a ship.
